prompt.vi: Làm hộp <Animated.View testID="box"> mờ dần từ opacity 0 lên 1 trong 150ms bằng Animated.timing (useNativeDriver: false). Sau 600ms opacity phải bằng 1.
prompt.en: Fade the <Animated.View testID="box"> from opacity 0 to 1 over 150ms with Animated.timing (useNativeDriver: false). After 600ms opacity must be 1.

hint.vi: const v = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current; Animated.timing(v, { toValue: 1, duration: 150, useNativeDriver: false }).start().
hint.en: const v = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current; Animated.timing(v, { toValue: 1, duration: 150, useNativeDriver: false }).start().

prompt.vi: Dùng interpolate: một Animated.Value chạy 0 → 1 trong 150ms; ánh xạ sang chiều rộng 50 → 200 qua value.interpolate({ inputRange:[0,1], outputRange:[50,200] }). Sau 600ms, <Animated.View testID="bar"> phải rộng 200px.
prompt.en: Use interpolate: an Animated.Value runs 0 → 1 over 150ms; map it to width 50 → 200 via value.interpolate({ inputRange:[0,1], outputRange:[50,200] }). After 600ms <Animated.View testID="bar"> must be 200px wide.
